overview.title: What is Amagi Life?
overview.text: Amagi Life is a regenerative village on Koh Phangan, Thailand, combining long-term living, shared land ownership, and a contribution-driven economy.

overview.title: Who joins Amagi Life?
overview.text: Amagi Life attracts location-independent professionals, founders, artists, practitioners, and families who want a stable long-term home base inside an intentional community. The current phase is explicitly for early adopters -- people who are open, adventurous, and comfortable stepping into a living project that is still taking shape.

overview.title: The Amagi Life Model
overview.text:
The model rests on three pillars: a hybrid ownership structure that lets residents invest in land and earn equity over time; affordable eco-conscious living that keeps nature, innovation, and community in sync; and cultural and entrepreneurial programming that drives engagement among people who share core values.

The name derives from ancient Sumerian -- the first recorded word for freedom -- translating roughly as 'return to the mother' or liberation through restoration. Amagi is built on regenerative land stewardship, shared ownership without forced collectivism, long-term affordability, and a living economic model that rewards contribution rather than extraction.

history.text:
Amagi Life was founded in 2024 by a Koh Phangan-based team with backgrounds in real estate development, blockchain, AI engineering, and social-impact venture building. The core idea: build a village model that addresses the three simultaneous failures of housing affordability, community fragility, and extractive development.

The team secured Hidden Valley, a site in the hills above Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, and began co-designing the first village with early residents. The [Amagi Village Podcast](https://open.spotify.com/show/6KGJfBnSkoP2aPlh1vPmpT) launched in early 2025, documenting the journey through conversations with community builders, entrepreneurs, and governance thinkers.

The first residents moved into Hidden Valley in May 2025. By late 2025 the community had run its first workshops, held a [public town hall on the model whitepaper](https://luma.com/p8b2rzz4), and published the foundational blog series on regenerative village design. Globally, 7+ villages across Peru, the US, Australia, and Thailand have signed letters of intent to join the Amagi network.

location:
Amagi Life's Hidden Valley sits in the hills above Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Surat Thani province, Thailand (address: 49/12 Ban Tai, Koh Phangan 84280). The site is a short drive -- about 5 minutes -- from Koh Phangan's cluster of international schools, making it practical for families.

Koh Phangan is a Gulf of Thailand island roughly 80 km from Surat Thani on the mainland and accessible by ferry from Koh Samui. The Ban Tai area on the island's south coast is quieter than the party-focused north and is home to a growing international residential community. The valley setting provides a natural buffer from road noise while remaining close to Ban Tai's amenities.
duration:
Amagi Life is designed for long-term residents rather than short-stay visitors or cohort rotations. There is no fixed minimum or maximum tenure announced; the model assumes members put down roots and participate in the village economy over time.

In its current early-adopter phase, Amagi is explicitly open to people comfortable with a living project that is still taking shape. Interested applicants should expect a 1:1 alignment call before any commitment, and engagement types range from full-time Villager to Investor to Partner -- each with a different level of on-site presence.
pricing:
Amagi Life uses a hybrid equity model rather than a fixed rent schedule. Three participation tiers are described on the site:

- **Full investment** -- pay the full villa value upfront; live rent-free and earn village equity over time.
- **Half investment** -- pay approximately half the villa value; receive a 50% rent discount and earn equity.
- **Contribution path** -- pay no upfront capital; pay an ongoing community-governed rent and earn equity through work and contribution.

The [Villa Investment Calculator](https://calculator.amagi.life/) on the Amagi site lets prospective residents model specific scenarios. Exact villa prices are shared during the application conversation rather than listed publicly. Contact [join@amagi.life](mailto:join@amagi.life) or apply at [amagi.life](https://amagi.life) to start the process.
amenities: Long-term accommodation (villas) in a jungle-valley setting
Shared land stewardship -- residents co-own and co-manage village grounds
Community governance -- rents are community-governed, not set by a landlord
Portable equity -- equity and rent reductions carry across future Amagi villages
Village venture-builder support for resident-run businesses (land, legal, or capital)
5-minute access to Koh Phangan's international schools
Proximity to Ban Tai town amenities and Koh Phangan's beaches
Amagi Village Podcast and ongoing educational content
Telegram community channel for residents and prospects

howToEnter.text:
Interested applicants start by filling in the application form at [amagi.life](https://amagi.life), selecting one of three engagement types -- Villager, Investor, or Partner. The form asks for contact details, a short motivation statement, participation preferences, and any social links you want to share.

After submission the team schedules a 1:1 alignment call to explore fit, answer questions, and agree on next steps together. Amagi is currently in its early-adopter phase and is looking for people who are self-responsible, emotionally mature, capable of cooperation, and genuinely interested in shaping the community as it grows.

faqs.question: What is Amagi Life and where is it located?
faqs.answer: Amagi Life is a regenerative village model combining long-term living, shared land stewardship, and a contribution-driven economy. Its first village -- Hidden Valley -- is in the hills above Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Thailand. Learn more at [amagi.life](https://amagi.life).

faqs.question: Is Amagi Life an intentional community or a co-housing project?
faqs.answer: It is both -- the team describes it as part co-housing project and part village venture builder. Residents share land governance and community programs while retaining individual autonomy. The model deliberately avoids forced collectivism.

faqs.question: How does the Amagi Life equity model work?
faqs.answer: Three tiers exist: (1) pay full villa value upfront -- live rent-free and earn equity; (2) pay roughly half -- receive a 50% rent discount and earn equity; (3) pay no capital upfront -- pay community-governed rent and earn equity through contribution over time. Equity is portable across all future Amagi villages.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to live at Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Specific villa prices are not listed publicly. The model is equity-based, so the upfront amount depends on the tier you choose. Use the [Villa Investment Calculator](https://calculator.amagi.life/) for scenario modelling or [apply](https://amagi.life) to get current figures from the team.

faqs.question: Who is Amagi Life for?
faqs.answer: Amagi is explicitly for early adopters -- location-independent professionals, founders, artists, practitioners, and families who want a long-term home base inside a values-aligned community. The team looks for people who are self-responsible, emotionally mature, and interested in co-shaping a living project.

faqs.question: How do I apply to Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Fill in the application form at [amagi.life](https://amagi.life), selecting Villager, Investor, or Partner as your engagement type. The team will follow up to schedule a 1:1 alignment call. You can also email [join@amagi.life](mailto:join@amagi.life) with questions.

faqs.question: Is Amagi Life good for families with children?
faqs.answer: Yes -- Amagi explicitly markets Hidden Valley to families. The site is about 5 minutes from Koh Phangan's international schools, and the community emphasizes safety, continuity, and a village-scale environment for daily life. The February 2026 blog post is titled 'Why Amagi's Hidden Valley Is a Perfect Community for Families Looking for Exceptional Education and a Natural Lifestyle.'

faqs.question: When did Amagi Life open and when did the first residents move in?
faqs.answer: Amagi Life was founded in 2024. The first residents moved into Hidden Valley in May 2025. The [Amagi Village Podcast](https://open.spotify.com/show/6KGJfBnSkoP2aPlh1vPmpT) launched in March 2025 and has documented the community's development from the start.

faqs.question: Is Amagi Life part of a larger network of villages?
faqs.answer: Yes. As of early 2026, 7+ villages across Peru, the US, Australia, and Thailand have signed letters of intent to join the Amagi network, with 10+ more in the pipeline. Equity earned at Hidden Valley is portable across all network villages.

faqs.question: Who are the founders and team behind Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: The core Koh Phangan team includes Ofer Rotem (17+ years of real estate development on the island), Thunj Chantramonklasri (tokenomics, ex-chief economist at Bitazza), Mikkel Fishman (AI engineer, ex-CEO of Arturo Labs), Dora Ho (venture builder, ex-CEO of Thrive in Thailand), Saar Kagan (product strategy), Guillaume de Maquillé (creative direction), and Benny Palinee (education and operations). See the full team and global advisors at [amagi.life/team](https://amagi.life/team).

faqs.question: Does Amagi Life have a whitepaper or model documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Amagi Model Whitepaper is available as a Google Doc linked from the main site. The team also holds public town halls to discuss the whitepaper and answer questions. Check [amagi.life](https://amagi.life) for the current link.

faqs.question: What advisors and investors are involved with Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Notable advisors include Patri Friedman (founder, Pronomos Capital -- the charter cities and network states venture fund), Balaji Srinivasan (co-founder Counsyl, former CTO of Coinbase, author of The Network State), Sergey Solonin (co-founder of Qiwi, builder of Nuanu), and Shannon Kalayanamitr (CEO of 5G Catalyst Technologies). Full list at [amagi.life/team](https://amagi.life/team).
